purpose: Compare retained/event/full costs at four fixed representatives of the H4 Pauli/DF PF/PR reversal; identify candidate mechanisms without unique causal shares or population claims

fixed.system: linear H4 adjacent1.00Angstrom STO-3G 8 system qubits; same saved state only as provenance, no state computation
fixed.df: tol-only1e-8 rank10; PR prefix1 plus one-body

selection: Pauli PF and DF PF singleton; Pauli PR and DF PR saved trajectory_index0. No cost-min/max or replacement trajectory. No RNG, no seed replay.

input_binding.binding_rule: Before future execution, verify SOURCE/ref, all used input bytes and actual runtime closure; never freeze unrelated worktrees. Exclude scientific state/matrix fields from evaluator.
input_binding.full_baseline_expectations: Use each selected.saved_cosine_RZ, not PR256 means; no new scientific aggregation.

pauli: Read original pauli.json and C Pauli blocks/components; match labels, coefficients, prefix/tail in source order without sorting or threshold updates.

Restore nested RTEEvent/RTEEventApplication/BasisReuseInterval from saved JSON, including signed products, phase complex pair, exact saved binary64 angle, outer/inner order. No _make_event, atan, distribution generation or sampler.

Reuse append_pauli_evolution and append_pauli_event. For each q step emit original forward retained half, r stored events, reverse half; apply original per-step scalar update. Build original generic whole-body control through hadamard_wrapper(already_controlled=False).
Do not use C collapsed operators, dense full matrices, changed control placement, synthetic old gate names or generic UnitaryGate replacements.
df: Read C model cases blocks: original RZ/XXPlusYY descriptions, ordered qubits/parameter strings/matrix SHA, diagonal RZ/RZZ/global_phase tokens and native_scalar_phases. Join event applications to same basis hash/support/sign/absolute coefficient and descriptions.

Restore standard RZGate/XXPlusYYGate from descriptor strings and preserve exact zeros/order/qubits/types. Invert original objects with original .inverse() ordering, not matrix-adjoint UnitaryGate. Verify local gate/ordered basis SHA in frozen runtime; no eigensolver/BogoliubovTransform/preparation call.

Use DFBasisRegistry and DFRTEEventSequenceCircuitRequest directly with original ids/hash/specs. Call existing QiskitDFRTEEventCircuitBuilder.build_sequence once per stored outer occurrence, preserve order and adjacent equal basis reuse; no make_df_partial_s2_repeated_request because it samples.

Deterministic block emitter narrowly substitutes stored primitives for the original primitive generator: inverse basis, append_diagonal_primitives(controlled=True,ancilla=8) in original RZZ/RZ/phase order, forward basis.

Within each step emit original scalar phases, forward blocks, occurrence, reverse blocks. Compose q steps using old raw sequence. No boundary_optimized or support-restricted basis. Reuse hadamard_wrapper(already_controlled=True).

Prepare q/r partitions only from saved outer_step_index/inner_RTE_position. q8 r4 are fixed; tail ids/hash for event requests must be jointly present or both None as API permits; never invent an original ID. Record any diagnostic-only provenance field.

ablation.policy: Delete only designated high-level groups before original control/compile; phases have disjoint owners; full emitter is never rebuilt by multiplying separately aggregated R/E.
ablation.retained: All forward and reverse retained blocks across all q steps plus constant, extracted identity and deterministic diagonal primitive phases. Remove all events. Do not merge boundaries or commuting terms manually.
ablation.event: Only the stored q groups of r events with order/negative-product/identity-rotation phases. No constant/extracted identity/deterministic primitive phase. Keep each occurrence's closing basis and phase before next occurrence; do not expand reuse across deleted gaps.
ablation.full: Original full operation and float accumulation order, including per-step phase placement and raw concatenation. Audit scalar_phase.angle is a summary, never emit that as a replacement lumped phase.
ablation.empty: QuantumCircuit(9,1) ancilla8 H,H,measurement. No controlled identity body, system/ancilla phase, state preparation, or compiler-visible tags.
ablation.phase_semantics: A system-global phase of the controlled evolution is ancilla-relative. It is not discardable. Do not alter floating summation/mod2pi order of the original full circuit. Isolation changes unitary; no new valid simulation or accuracy claim.

reproduction_gate.before_compile: Verify input/old source/runtime SHA, 4 joins, trajectory and event IDs, config, exact gate descriptors/local hashes, phase control branches and source schedule. All four reconstructed full recursive input fingerprints must match before any cost transpile; otherwise STOP.
reproduction_gate.auto_name: Old hashes exist but custom names participate. Do not brute-force names, relabel to force an old hash, ignore a mismatching field or introduce a normalized hash as old evidence. New normalized descriptor hash may be stored only as supplementary provenance.
reproduction_gate.old_cost: Full four exact integer RZ equal each saved_cosine_RZ; compiler settings equal. Any failure => no ablation compile/adoption. Save failure receipt, no retry or extra invocation.
reproduction_gate.identity_limit: Even all hashes/prices equal proves corresponding input and count under fixed runtime, not bitwise identity to the lost old compiled program. Never claim old native PASS or old program recovery.
reproduction_gate.mapping: No numerical Hamiltonian/operator reconstruction for proof; a source-line mapping plus local descriptor, phase/order checks is required and recorded. Missing scientifically necessary correspondence => STOP.

execution_order.stage_A: After new explicit execution approval and seal, reconstruct four full inputs without RNG; check all input hashes before cost compilation. No H4 circuit is constructed during this preparation.
execution_order.stage_B: At most four full cost compilations (parallel if practical), persist results and require all4 exact reproduction PASS.
execution_order.stage_C: Only after all4 full PASS, compile four PR ablations plus shared empty (at most5); can run independent workers. No retry or extra variants.
execution_order.budget_definition: 9 explicit top-level transpile_and_measure_cost calls, no prior persistent cost reuse masquerading as a fresh compilation. Internal _unroll_gate/BasisTranslator passes needed for old generic .control are builder work, recorded separately; no additional price transpile, backend transpile or hidden diagnostic variant.
execution_order.cache: New own empty cache or direct compiler function; save exactly one input/output per variant. Any failed call is spent, not refundable or automatically retried.

measured: RZ/CX depth if existing function supplies them
DF returned application/basis-switch/reuse counters per occurrence
metrics.before_control: Pauli source body exists before wrapper. DF virtual source histogram and pre-control central tags are collected during same schedule emission, not another whole H4 counterfactual circuit. Mark native central-control path and unavailable global after-control ratio as not directly comparable.
metrics.tags: Sidecar interval/range/group IDs only; no barriers, labels, gate names or metadata edits that change compiler input. Nested axes: role=retained/event/scalar/wrapper; kind=basis/Pauli/diagonal/control; do not double count nested categories or force assign every final RZ.
metrics.missing: Unavailable optional metric is null with reason; required RZ/CX/depth/program/hash and full reproduction gate cannot be silently skipped.

compiler_trace.reason: Existing transpile_and_measure_cost exposes pre/post metrics but no callback. Do not add a callback, custom passmanager, alternate optimization or second compilation for trace in D1.
compiler_trace.stage_pass_trace: null with reason NO_CALLBACK_IN_FIXED_WRAPPER; retain fixed runtime source pass map as possible mechanism, not actual execution trace
compiler_trace.generic_control_trace: Record known source pathway and before/after histograms; internal actual pass invocation trace may be absent, explicitly null.

comparisons.sign: Keep signed integers, including negative increments/interactions. No clipping, fitting or additive allocation.
comparisons.depth: Report each depth; no additive depth budget or claimed causal depth contribution.
comparisons.H1: Compare isolated retained prices/increments across Pauli/DF at index0 and their context dependence. Does not identify effect of Z/ZZ retention alone or a unique dominant share.
comparisons.H2: Compare whole stored event-stream prices and tags at index0. No event-mean or component frequency aggregation; laws/angles differ and comparison is not matched.
comparisons.H3: Locate basis tags in retained and event and report actual source counters; compiled cost attributable specifically to basis remains unidentified.
comparisons.H4: Exact nonzero interaction demonstrates nonadditivity for the selected case; report magnitude and signs, no invented significance threshold, no unique boundary/compiler causal split.
comparisons.H5: Generic-control source and histogram expansion motivate D2 if unresolved. D1 alone cannot estimate equivalent-central-control counterfactual cost.
comparisons.claim_limit: Four selected representatives, no revised means, statistical confidence, population guarantee, certificate or general Pauli/DF superiority. Old PF/PR costs remain unchanged.

GO_STOP.GO: Separate user execution approval; production adapter implemented with artificial tests, new source/runtime/input seal, fresh one-shot grant; all pre-execution checks; full4 correspondence and exact cost reproduction before ablations.
STOP: actual OOM or own job/input corruption
GO_STOP.not_STOP: Unrelated worktree updates, shared CPU contention or transient PSI/monitoring delay alone; record observation and re-establish monitor without killing healthy workers.
GO_STOP.partial: Persist diagnostic failure/partial output; no complete PASS, no old-result attribution; no replacement trajectory/extra compile/automatic retry.
GO_STOP.final: Complete/failed scope always stops; no D2/D3/numerical next stage automatically.

activation_procedure: User explicitly approves finite D1 build+compile and diagnostic count arithmetic, separately from current preparation.

Within that authorized next scope, implement minimal descriptor hydration and schedule connector reusing old primitive/event/wrapper/compiler functions. Artificial phase, inverse, grouping, fingerprint and quota tests first; no original source modifications.

Commit new production source; pin actual old reference-compatible runtime closure and exact selected inputs. Freeze contract, executor, output schema and own process lifecycle; confirm SOURCE/runtime/input correspondence.

Create separate active contract from this immutable draft with approval reference and content hashes; require committed source and runtime SHA plus explicit approval and one-use grant, not flags alone.
Issue a new grant only after approval and all technical gates. Exclusive claim before any real build; durable call ledger per top-level compile and failure; source/input audits before/after.
Native supervisor records actual exit, worker identities/reap and persistence. Save new STOP for D1 only; retain original native UNKNOWN.
Publish scope/results only under repository authorization; STOP and return to user.
artificial_validation: check_preparation.py: phase ownership, exact-9 scope, strict baseline/fingerprint failures, mock recursive gate-name sensitivity, signed nonadditive algebra; 7 existing native-gate artificial tests reused

followups.D2: Separate approval, at most2 new Pauli specialized-control compiles only if D1 baselines accepted and control question remains. Not implemented here.
followups.D3: Separate approval, at most1 DF reuse-off compile only if actual D1 returned cancelled equal-basis pairs>0. Otherwise no contrast and skip without selecting another trajectory.
followups.prefix_law: Different research series with a physical matched criterion; not D1 optimization.

resources: No arbitrary low CPU/RAM/worker caps. Parallelize independent four baselines or five later diagnostics when useful; preserve dependencies and exact finite call budget. Own directories/processes only, no shared environment/system settings/other users touched.
current_STOP: Preparation complete, real_H4_runner_started=false; no new grant, build, compile, sampling, scientific aggregation or shot/N_G accounting. Original N_G null/C_L blocked/compiler missing/native unknown unchanged.
